I'm Nova, a small Python chatbot trained to recognize intents.
Call me Nova. I run locally using a Naive Bayes model.
I can answer focused questions from my training data. Edit data/intents.json and retrain me to add skills.
I classify your message by intent, then choose a matching response. Ask about Python, AI, or training.
Python is a readable programming language widely used for AI, APIs, automation, and data science.
Start Python with variables, conditions, loops, functions, and small projects. Consistent practice matters more than memorizing syntax.
AI systems perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. Machine learning models learn statistical patterns from examples.
A model is a mathematical system fitted to training data so it can make predictions on new inputs.
Add patterns and responses to data/intents.json, then run `python train.py`. Restart the server after training.
Better examples make this bot better: add varied phrases for each intent, retrain, and test with messages it has not seen.
A super-intelligent AI is not a realistic beginner project. Start with a focused chatbot, measure it carefully, then upgrade it with retrieval or an existing language model.
Training a frontier language model from scratch requires enormous data and computing. This project teaches the core loop on a safe, understandable scale.
FastAPI exposes the chatbot through POST /api/chat. It also serves the browser interface and interactive documentation at /docs.
The browser sends JSON to the FastAPI backend, which runs the local model and returns a response with its intent and confidence.
